elements_selected.content: Public-repo safety per REQ-3423 + ADR-3409 (BUG-013 resolution). Detect public hosting: (a) explicit `[vault] visibility = "public"` declaration, OR (b) git-origin heuristic (github.com without private-org token, gitlab.com, codeberg.org, etc.). If detected, refuse to read `.zetl/caps/grants.toml` in the repo tree; require `[access.grants_file_external]` pointing outside the repo; emit stub `grants-committed.toml` containing only cohort salts + IDs (no recipients, no grant metadata).
